messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate observed on edge-router service (svc=edge-router-prod) — starting incident channel. Please acknowledge. Correlation samples: c0a1b2c3, c7f8e9d0. Logs pushed to /incidents/2349999001/logbundle.txt

sanjay: oncall here, taking lead. joining call in 2. Can someone post impact numbers?

mira: seeing ~18% 5xx for the last 6m on edge-router. Error class: upstream_timeout and gateway_reset. Top affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Customer-facing: increased latency and failed requests for low concurrency bursts.

lena: confirmed, synthetic checks failing in us-west-2. spike started ~2349998700 according to synthetic-runner.

ops-bot: Runbook auto-suggest: possible causes= [ingress-saturation, upstream-runtime-timeout, spike in large-context requests]. Suggested mitigations: scale edge-router, open fallback route, enable short-circuit cache.

sanjay: quick mitigation plan: 1) scale edge-router +2 pods, 2) open fallback routing to model-compact variant, 3) set short-term 10r/s per-tenant rate limit for high QPS keys. Doing 1 and 2 now.

cameron: pls paste the exact kubectl command for scale so I can run it in parallel.

sanjay: running: ``kubectl -n prod scale deploy/edge-router --replicas=6`` (was 4)

mira: routing change applied: traffic split 85% -> edge-router, 15% -> edge-router-compact (fallback). Observing 20s to propagate to LB.

lena: posting a short log sample around one of the correlation ids:
```
2024-04-12T16:10:22Z edge-router [corr=c0a1b2c3] "POST /v1/generate" 502 upstream_timeout upstream=runtime-12.fq45 status=504 rt=2.34s
2024-04-12T16:10:23Z edge-router [corr=c0a1b2c3] route->runtime-12 request-id=abc-123 latency=2.33s upstream-err=timeout
```

mira: runtime-12 logs show repeated recv stalls before timeout, KV cache hits steady. Looks like worker threads stuck on big sequences.

kb-bot: Correlation aggregation: 52% of 5xx share prefix "upstream_timeout"; top upstreams: runtime-12, runtime-9, runtime-21.

sanjay: hypothesis A: one or more upstream runtimes (runtime-12/9) are hitting a memory/CPU regression causing long stalls, cascading to gateway timeouts. Hypothesis B: sudden increase in very long-context requests causing backlog + overload.

lena: can we get a quick histogram of request token counts for the last 15m?

mira: histogram (top bucket): >8k tokens = 14% of requests but 60% of cpu time. Posting snippet: ``tokens>8000: 420 reqs; tokens 0-512: 2400 reqs``

cameron: that aligns with B. mitigation: enable request-size-based throttling for now. sanjay, can you add a temporary limiter?

sanjay: adding limiter for requests with token_estimate > 6000 -> reject with 429 for 5m window. Pushing rule to ingress WAF now.

ops-bot: Mitigation applied: ingress-rule-id=ir-2349, action=429 for large-context.

mira: after routing fallback + scale + limiter: 5xx rate down from 18% -> 4% in 6m. Latency p95 improved from 1.8s -> 0.9s.

sanjay: good. continuing data collection. we should build timeline and collect full KV logs for runtime-12. lena, can you dump heap/cpu metrics?

lena: attached metrics snapshot to /incidents/2349999001/metrics/ — heap growth on runtime-12 process pid 2234 from 1.1GB -> 2.8GB over 12m, cpu oscillations to 95%.

mira: note: runtime-12 had a config change last deploy (quantization tweak) 3 days ago. rollout id: r-2024-04-10-qq.

kb-bot: Deploy cross-check: runtime-12 and runtime-9 both ran r-2024-04-10-qq. runtime-21 on older build. correlation suggests deploy-linked regression.

sanjay: tentative RCA: regression in recent runtime build increases memory pressure on long-context workloads leading to worker stalls -> gateway upstream_timeout -> elevated 5xx. Next steps: 1) revert runtime quant tweak on runtime-12/9, 2) scale to stabilize, 3) replay top failing requests to confirm locally.

cameron: I'll kick off a controlled canary revert for runtime-12 cluster and run replay harness. sending revert PR now.

mira: customer-impact note: affected requests were mostly long-document batch generations, impacting a few enterprise customers doing semantic-index ingests. Not widespread but high severity for those tenants. Notified customer-success.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial. Current 5xx 3.7%. Actions in progress: revert PR, replay failures, postmortem drafting.

sanjay: handoff: I'm on for 30m then pass to mira for monitoring and postmortem. Will leave a checklist in this thread.

lena: checklist items added: 
- attach full runtime logs (done) -> /incidents/2349999001/logbundle.txt
- metrics dump (done) -> /incidents/2349999001/metrics/
- revert PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/runtimes/+/PR-452
- replay job id: replay-2349 (queued)

mira: replay started, will share diff of error rates between pre/post revert.

kb-bot: Reminder: capture correlation ids for failing requests for postmortem. Use tag `corr:` for search.

sanjay: ACK. final note before handoff: mitigation worked, but root cause likely runtime regression triggered by long-context workload. Postmortem owners: mira (lead), sanjay (actions), cameron (repro), lena (metrics).

mira: taking postmortem. will create incident page and link here. closing channel when postmortem live. :white_check_mark:
